title: SEO and Social Media Growth Specialist (Home Remodeling and Construction)
description:
### Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced SEO and Digital Growth Specialist who can help increase our online visibility, improve Google rankings, generate qualified leads, and position our company as a trusted authority in the luxury home remodeling industry.



The ideal candidate has proven experience with local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, AI search visibility, content strategy, keyword research, and website optimization. Social media experience is a plus, but the primary focus of this role is driving organic traffic, search rankings, and lead generation through Google and emerging AI search platforms.



### Responsibilities



* Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy focused on lead generation.

* Conduct keyword research related to remodeling, ADUs, kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, home additions, and luxury home construction.

* Optimize website content, service pages, blogs, and landing pages for search engines and conversions.

* Improve local SEO performance and Google Maps rankings.

* Manage and optimize Google Business Profile listings.

* Create and implement content strategies that target homeowners actively searching for remodeling services.

* Identify opportunities to improve website structure, on-page SEO, internal linking, metadata, and user experience.

* Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and lead generation performance.

* Develop strategies to improve visibility in AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overview, Gemini, and Perplexity.

* Analyze competitors and identify opportunities to outperform them in local search results.

* Create SEO-focused content recommendations for blogs, project showcases, FAQs, and service pages.

* Provide monthly reports outlining performance, growth opportunities, and recommendations.

* Support social media content planning to ensure alignment with SEO and search visibility goals.



### Qualifications



* Minimum 3+ years of proven SEO experience.

* Strong understanding of Local SEO, Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, and Content SEO.

* Experience optimizing Google Business Profiles and local service businesses.

* Experience working with remodeling, construction, architecture, home improvement, or related industries preferred.

* Knowledge of AI search optimization and emerging search trends.

* Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, BrightLocal, or similar platforms.

* Strong content strategy and keyword research skills.

* Ability to translate SEO efforts into measurable lead generation results.

* Excellent analytical and reporting capabilities.

* Understanding of social media content strategy and its impact on search visibility.



### Required Application Materials



To be considered, applicants must submit:



* Examples of websites they have optimized and ranked on Google.

* Specific SEO results achieved, including ranking improvements, organic traffic growth, and lead generation metrics.

* Examples of Google Business Profiles managed and optimized.

* A brief SEO strategy explaining how they would help increase visibility and generate leads for our company.

* Portfolio of content, blogs, landing pages, or SEO campaigns created.

* Resume and relevant certifications.

* A short video (2–3 minutes) explaining:



* Their SEO experience.

* How they would improve our website's rankings.

* How they would generate more qualified remodeling leads through Google and AI search.

title: Guest Support Specialist for Airbnb / Short-Term Rental Company
description:
We are Sophari — a premium short-term rental company operating furnished apartments across downtown Bellevue, WA (near Seattle, USA). We serve corporate professionals, relocating tech employees, and extended-stay travelers, with guests booking through platforms like Airbnb, 
, and other online travel agencies.



We are a small, close-knit remote team where everyone does the core work. No one is above answering a guest message, logging a note, or following up on a reservation detail. If you like being hands-on and part of a high-ownership team, you will fit in well.



We are looking for a reliable, experienced Guest Support Specialist based in the Philippines to join us full-time, handle guest communications, resolve issues across our platforms, and support day-to-day guest operations.



About the Role

Full-time, remote role for candidates based in the Philippines.



Core schedule:



Weekdays (Monday–Friday): 3:00pm–11:00pm Pacific Time



Weekends (Saturday–Sunday): 10:00am–5:00pm Pacific Time



Weekend coverage on both days is required. If you are able to consistently work full weekend coverage, we can offer up to $8/hour.



You will work across several tools, including a property management system such as Guesty or Jurny, plus Airtable and Breezeway for tracking, coordination, and operations workflows.



This role is focused on reliable shift coverage, strong guest communication, and accurate execution of process.



What You Will Do

Monitor and respond to guest messages across booking channels such as Airbnb, 
, and direct reservations.



Handle common guest issues such as late check-ins, lockouts, extension requests, parking questions, Wi-Fi issues, and general stay support.



Log guest interactions, notes, and follow-ups accurately and in real time.



Coordinate with operations and cleaning teams on same-day issues, unit readiness, and turnover flags.



Work inside our systems and workflows, including a PMS such as Guesty or Jurny, Airtable, and Breezeway.



Identify and flag upsell opportunities such as early check-in, late checkout, parking, and extra cleaning, and send payment instructions when appropriate.



Escalate discount requests, pricing exceptions, and unusual situations according to our internal process.



What We Are Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in short-term rental operations, property management, hotel front desk, or hospitality guest support.



Strong written English and professional guest communication.



Experience with Airbnb, 
, Agoda, Expedia, or similar OTA platforms.



Organized and reliable; you log notes in real time, show up on schedule, and follow through on tasks.



Comfortable working independently from home while coordinating with a small remote team.



Calm, practical, and solution-focused when guests are frustrated or situations are unclear.



Comfortable learning and using systems such as a PMS (Guesty, Jurny, or similar), Airtable, and Breezeway.



What This Is Not

This is not a sales or account management role; it is a guest support and operations role.



This is not a high-autonomy pricing role; there are clear escalation paths for discounts and exceptions.



This is not a fit for someone juggling too many demanding clients at once; we need dependable coverage during scheduled hours.



Compensation and Growth

$5–$7/hour to start, depending on experience and fit.



Up to $8/hour for candidates who can consistently work full coverage on both weekend days.



Full-time hours based on the schedule above.



Paid onboarding and training period.



90-day review with the opportunity to revisit pay and responsibilities.



Room to grow as the company adds properties and expands operations.



How to Apply

Please answer all of the following in your application:



Describe your short-term rental, hotel, or hospitality guest support experience. Include number of properties or rooms supported, platforms used, and how long you did the work.



Confirm your availability for this schedule:



Weekdays: 3:00pm–11:00pm Pacific Time



Weekends: 10:00am–5:00pm Pacific Time



Confirm whether you can work both Saturday and Sunday on a regular basis.



Share your experience using any of the following: Guesty, Jurny, Airtable, Breezeway, or similar tools.



Share one example of a difficult guest situation you handled, what you did, and the outcome.



We take this hire seriously. Clear, direct, and specific applications stand out much more than long generic ones.

Virtual Assistant – Jules Comfort Stays



Location: Remote (Work from Home)

Salary: Starting from $500 per month + Bonuses + Commission



About Us



Jules Comfort Stays is a growing serviced accommodation company providing high-quality accommodation for business travellers, contractors, insurance guests, relocation clients and families throughout the UK.



We are looking for a proactive, organised and professional Virtual Assistant to become a key part of our growing team. We need someone who is reliable, thinks ahead, uses initiative and takes ownership of their work.



Guest Communication



Respond promptly to guest enquiries.



Provide exceptional customer service before, during and after each stay.



Handle guest issues professionally and efficiently.



Maintain a friendly, welcoming and professional tone at all times.



Ensure guest satisfaction and encourage positive reviews.



Answer guest calls and messages in a timely manner.



Assist guests with check-in instructions, property information and any issues that arise during their stay.



Property Operations



Monitor guest check-outs and organise cleaners immediately after departure.



Ensure every property is cleaned and ready before new guest arrivals.



Coordinate cleaning schedules using our channel management software (Uplisting).



Monitor property readiness and report any issues.



Ensure all properties meet Jules Comfort Stays' standards before each guest arrival.



Booking & Channel Management



Manage bookings through Airbnb, 
, VRBO and other online travel agencies.



Use Uplisting to track arrivals, departures and cleaning schedules.



Update calendars and booking information.



Ensure all properties remain accurately listed and managed.



Monitor occupancy and report any booking opportunities.



Maintenance & Contractor Management



Take initiative when maintenance issues arise.



Contact approved plumbers, electricians, handymen and contractors as required.



Follow up on repairs until they are completed.



Maintain records of maintenance issues and resolutions.



Manage teams of cleaners and contractors across multiple properties.



For example:



If a boiler stops working, you will arrange a plumber.



If there is an electrical issue, you will arrange an electrician.



If furniture requires repair, you will arrange a handyman.



If additional cleaning is required, you will organise the cleaning team.



If a guest reports a maintenance issue, you will take ownership of resolving it promptly.



Business Development & Outreach



This role is not just administrative. We are looking for someone who can actively help grow the business.



You will be expected to:



Research and identify insurance accommodation providers.



Research and identify contractor accommodation companies.



Research and identify relocation companies.



Research and identify corporate accommodation providers.



Build relationships with local businesses requiring accommodation.



Help increase occupancy across all Jules Comfort Stays properties.



 Outreach



You will regularly send professional
s to:



Insurance companies



Insurance accommodation providers



Loss adjusters



Relocation companies



Construction companies



Contractor firms



Corporate travel departments



Local businesses requiring accommodation for staff



The goal is to introduce Jules Comfort Stays, build relationships and secure long-term accommodation bookings for our properties.



You will be provided with guidance, templates and training, but we are looking for someone who can use initiative and confidently communicate with businesses on behalf of the company.



Requirements



Excellent written and spoken English.



Professional and friendly communication skills.



Strong organisational skills.



Excellent customer service skills.



Ability to work independently.



Excellent attention to detail.



Ability to solve problems and use initiative.



Experience with Airbnb, 
 or serviced accommodation is beneficial but not essential.



Communication & Equipment Requirements



To be considered for this position, you must have:



A stable and reliable high-speed internet connection.



A smartphone or telephone capable of making and receiving calls.



A laptop or desktop computer suitable for managing bookings and communications.



Availability to respond to urgent guest enquiries when required.



A quiet and professional working environment.



You will be expected to communicate with guests, cleaners, contractors and company partners in a professional and friendly manner at all times.



Performance Bonuses5-Star Review Bonus



Receive a bonus for every five 5-star reviews received across our properties.



Response Time Bonus



Receive bonuses for maintaining excellent guest response times.



Initiative Bonus



Additional bonuses will be awarded when initiative is shown and problems are solved without requiring constant supervision.



Growth Bonus



As the company grows, additional responsibilities and pay increases will become available.



Commission StructureLong-Term Booking Commission



You will receive:



10% commission on any long-term booking that you personally secure through your outreach efforts.



This includes bookings from:



Insurance accommodation providers



Insurance companies



Contractors



Corporate clients



Relocation companies



Local businesses



This commission is paid in addition to your monthly salary and performance bonuses.



Additional Work Bonus



At Jules Comfort Stays, we believe in rewarding hard work and initiative.



In addition to your salary, commission and performance bonuses, you will receive additional bonuses for:



Taking on extra responsibilities.



Completing work outside of your normal duties.



Assisting with special projects.



Helping onboard new properties.



Creating new systems or improving existing processes.



Successfully solving difficult guest or operational issues.



Supporting the growth and expansion of the business.



Assisting with marketing and social media content.



Helping source new contractors, suppliers or business opportunities.



We value tea
mbers who go above and beyond. If you consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative and a positive attitude, there will be opportunities for increased earnings, promotions and greater responsibility within the company.



Career Progression



This role has the potential to grow into:



Senior Virtual Assistant



Operations Manager



Property Manager



Business Development Manager



As Jules Comfort Stays continues to expand, we are committed to rewarding loyal tea
mbers who contribute to the company's success.



Salary & Benefits



Starting Salary: $500 per month



Plus:



5-Star Review Bonuses



Response Time Bonuses



Initiative Bonuses



Additional Work Bonuses



Growth Bonuses



10% Commission on Long-Term Bookings Secured



Career Progression Opportunities



Apply



Please send your CV and a short introduction explaining why you would be a great fit for Jules Comfort Stays.



: 



Jules Comfort Stays

"Where Comfort Feels Like Home."

title: Magazine Designer – Luxury Magazine Layout & Production (Remote / Part-Time)
description:
VEI™ (Vegas Equity Insider) is a growing homeowner and lifestyle publication serving Las Vegas, Nevada.



We are seeking a talented Magazine Designer who can help create a premium, luxury-quality publication each month.



This role is responsible for turning articles, advertisements, and content into a polished magazine that looks professional, modern, and visually appealing.



We are looking for someone who understands layout, typography, visual hierarchy, and magazine production.



This is not a social media design position.



This is a publication design position.



Responsibilities

Design monthly magazine layouts

Create visually appealing page designs

Format contributor articles

Place advertisements within the publication

Maintain brand consistency

Create print-ready PDF files

Assist with Canva templates when needed

Work with Publisher and Managing Editor to finalize each issue

Requirements

Strong graphic design skills

Magazine layout experience

Excellent typography skills

Canva experience

Ability to create luxury and professional designs

Strong attention to detail

Reliable communication

Ability to meet deadlines

Preferred Qualifications

Adobe InDesign experience

Canva Pro experience

Publication design experience

Real estate or lifestyle publication experience

Print production experience

What Success Looks Like



Every month, VEI is delivered as a polished, luxury-quality publication that readers are proud to share and advertisers are proud to appear in.



The final publication should look comparable to premium local magazines and business publications.



About VEI™



VEI™ is a growing Las Vegas publication focused on:



Real Estate

Wealth Building

Lifestyle

Wellness

Community

Local Business



Outstanding tea
mbers will have opportunities to grow with the company as new publications and media projects launch.



Application Instructions



Please begin your application with the words:



"VEI Designer"



and answer the following questions:



How many magazines or publications have you designed?

Which design tools do you use most often?

Describe your design style.

Why are you interested in this position?

What makes you a strong fit for a luxury publication?

Required Portfolio Submission



To be considered for this position, you MUST provide the following:



Three (3) examples of magazine layouts or publication designs you have personally created.

At least one example should demonstrate multi-page magazine formatting.

At least one example should demonstrate strong typography and article layout.

PDF samples are preferred.



Applications submitted without publication or magazine design samples will not be considered.



What We're Looking For



We are not looking for logo designers or social media graphic designers.



We are specifically looking for someone who can create clean, professional, luxury-quality magazine layouts that are visually engaging, easy to read, and advertiser-friendly.



The ideal candidate understands:



Typography

Editorial design

Page hierarchy

White space

Luxury branding

Print-ready production

• After Regularization:

title: Property Insurance Inspection Quality Control Specialist
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Insurance Inspection Quality Control & Quality Assurance Specialist. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the accuracy and quality of property inspection reports. You will work closely with our operations team to maintain industry-leading standards with our evaluation processes.



Key Responsibilities:



Quality Control Review & Assurance:



- Examine and validate property insurance inspection reports prepared by outside contractors for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to industry standards.

- Develop and implement quality assurance protocols and checklists tailored to property insurance inspection reports.

- Work with with outside contractors to clarify report requirements, negotiate revisions, and ensure report consistency.

- Conduct regular reviews of contractor work and provide actionable feedback.



Regulatory & Industry Compliance:



- Stay updated on current insurance loss control and prevention standards, NFPA, OSHA, and other relevant safety regulations.

- Ensure all reports comply with internal and external guidelines, best industry practices, and applicable legal requirements.



Process Improvement:



- Recommend and implement enhancements to both the inspection process and the quality review procedures.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine and optimize overall documentation and loss control strategies.



Documentation & Record Keeping:



- Maintain comprehensive and accurate records of review findings, corrective actions, and quality improvements.

- Develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) and training materials for quality assurance.



Educational and Career Background:



Prior experience with quality control of insurance loss control property inspections is *highly preferred*.

Prior experience with the commercial insurance industry (rating, underwriting, applications) is preferred.

Familiarity with insurance property inspections is preferred.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related field is preferred. 

Construction background is also preferred.



Industry Experience:



Expertise in interpreting and reviewing technical inspection reports (especially property inspections) is preferred.



Technical Competencies:



- Understanding of loss control methodologies, building and fire safety principles, and regulatory requirements (e.g., NFPA, OSHA) is preferred

- Proficiency with MS Office Suite and web-based applications.



Analytical & Communication Skills:



- Exceptional attention to detail with a strong ability to analyze complex technical data and identify discrepancies.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the capacity to convey technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

- Proven ability to provide constructive feedback and effectively manage contractor relationships.



Problem Solving & Process Improvement:



- Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing quality control processes and identifying process improvements.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment.

title: AU Asset Finance
description:
Asset Finance Support

Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.



To Apply, please submit this form:  



What You'll Be Doing Every Day



Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Preparing and submitting finance applications to lenders via broker portals

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention





You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements



Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have



Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: Graphic Designer - Part Time (Remote)
description:
The Compliance Services Organization didn’t exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation’s largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we’re actively building — and leading.



What we do:

We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice’s behalf.



Why it matters:

Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We’re changing that — and we’re looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology:

We’re actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you’re in the right place.



Our impact:

Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready.



Position Overview:

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions compete in a market where first impressions are made visually — across paid ads, landing pages, sales collateral, and brand touchpoints that span two distinct but related brands. The Graphic Designer owns the visual execution layer for both, producing digital and print assets that are on-brand, conversion-focused, and built to perform in a high-volume marketing environment.



This is not a passive production role. The right person brings creative instincts and design craft to every asset, understands how design decisions affect conversion and brand perception, and operates with enough independence to move fast without constant direction. Quality, consistency, and speed across two brands is the standard.



Key Responsibilities:

Digital Design:

• Design high-converting paid ad creative for Google Display, Meta 
/Instagram), and Reddit across both MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions — including static, carousel, and banner formats in all required platform dimensions.

• Create landing page visual assets, hero images, icons, and supporting graphics that align with campaign objectives and brand standards.

• Design social media graphics,
 headers, and digital content assets for ongoing marketing programs across both brands.

• Produce visual assets for web properties including comparison sites, client-facing tools, and web forms — in close coordination with the Web Developer.

• Iterate quickly on creative variations for A/B testing — resizing, copy swaps, color variants, and format adaptations without sacrificing design quality.



Print & Brand Collateral:

• Design and produce print-ready sales collateral including one-pagers, brochures, sell sheets, and case study layouts for both brands.

• Create branded presentation templates, pitch decks, and internal documents that maintain visual consistency across the organization.

• Develop and maintain brand style elements — iconography, typography applications, color usage, and layout templates — that ensure consistency across all market-facing surfaces.

• Support campaign launches with print materials, event graphics, and partner co-branded assets as needed.



Brand Consistency & Creative Operations:

• Maintain and enforce visual brand standards across both MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions — ensuring every asset, across every channel, looks like it belongs to the same professional organization.

• Organize and maintain a shared asset library of approved brand elements, templates, and production files that the broader team can access and use.

• Collaborate with the Paid Media Manager, SEO & AEO Specialist, and Web Developer to ensure design assets are correctly sized, formatted, and optimized for their intended platform and purpose.

• Manage multiple concurrent design requests through Asana, prioritizing effectively and communicating proactively when timelines are at risk.



Qualifications:

Required:

• 3+ years of graphic design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating both digital and print work — portfolio submission is required and will be the primary evaluation criteria.

• Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite — specifically Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. This is non-negotiable; candidates must demonstrate mastery, not familiarity.

• Proven experience designing paid digital ad creative across Google Display, Meta, and similar platforms — with an understanding of what makes ad creative perform, not just look good.

• Solid print design experience: bleed setup, CMYK color management, print-ready file preparation, and working with print production specifications.

• Strong typography skills and a sharp eye for layout, hierarchy, and visual balance across both digital and print formats.

• Experience maintaining brand consistency across multiple brands or product lines simultaneously.

• Asana or equivalent project management tool experience — able to self-manage a queue of concurrent design requests without micromanagement.

• High proficiency with AI design tools (Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or equivalent) for concept generation, image enhancement, and accelerating production workflows. We expect AI to be a standard part of how this person works.

• Excellent written English for creative briefs, revision requests, and cross-team communication.

• Must be available to overlap with U.S. Central Standard Time (CST) business hours for collaboration and feedback cycles.



Nice-to-Have:

• Experience with Figma or similar tools for web-adjacent design work and handoff to developers.

• Motion graphics or basic video editing capability (After Effects, Premiere, or Canva Pro) for social and ad content.

• Experience designing for healthcare, B2B SaaS, or compliance-driven brands.

• Canva Pro proficiency for rapid template creation and lightweight asset production.

• Experience working with U.S.-based marketing teams remotely, with strong cross-cultural communication skills.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive hourly rate of $5–$8/hour USD, based on experience and portfolio strength

• Part-time role (20 hours/week) with flexible scheduling and weekly pay

• 100% remote work — work from anywhere in the Philippines

• Long-term engagement with growth potential within a U.S.-based organization

• Collaborative and performance-driven culture focused on professional development and results

• Exposure to U.S. marketing operations, brand strategy, and multi-brand creative environments

• Opportunity to grow your portfolio working across paid media, print, and digital channels



Technical Requirements:

• Personal laptop or desktop capable of running Adobe Creative Suite without lag

• Stable primary internet connection (at least 25–30 Mbps) with a backup internet source

• Quiet, dedicated work environment



Application Process:

To apply, please submit the following:

2. Send it to these

4. Brief introduction about your experience and why you’re a fit for this role



Portfolio submissions without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: ADVICE ASSOCIATE  (URGENT - FINANCIAL ADVICE )
description:
ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY (APPLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE)

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: AUD$10-$15ph



ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED

LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team.



FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES

1. The Information Steward

- Custodian of all essential client information and access rights.

- Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc.

- Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements).

- Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times.

- Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence.

- Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly.

- Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms.

- Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management.

- Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?”



2. The Delivery Project Manager

- Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines.

- Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval.

- Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks.

- Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution.

- Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome.

- Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals.

- Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties.

- Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?”



3. The Relationship Anchor

- Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client.

- Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly.

- Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients.

- Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life.

- Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings.

- Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal.

- Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting.

- Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates.

- Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?”



4. The Compliant Storyteller

- Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story.

- Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes.

- Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up
s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information.

- Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised.

- Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions.

- Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals.

- Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered.

- Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?”



PRIORITISATION ORDER

- From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order:

- Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction.

- Insurance applications and getting policies into force.

- Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting
s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser.

- Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour).

- Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding).

- Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc).

- Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority.

- Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task.



REPORTING & COLLABORATION

Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes.

Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser.



Indicators of Success

- 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access.

- Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention.

- High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients.

- Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work.

- Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio.

- Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours.

- Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms.



Expected Behaviour

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable.

- Thoughtful and detail-oriented.

- Able to prioritise and escalate as needed.

- Collaborative, not siloed.

- Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency.



APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply, please submit the following:

• A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are the best fit for this role

• Your updated CV and LinkedIn profile link

• Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal)



Please apply and
 all details to: 

ONLY those who follow the instructions in how to apply will be accommodated.

We are not looking for someone who only edits photos.



We are not looking for someone who just types a prompt and sends the first result.



We are looking for someone with a genuine eye for fashion. Someone who understands how a brand should feel, can study raw inputs and references, and translate them into polished, realistic, on-brand AI-generated visuals without constant direction.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Receive raw product images, brand references, campaign direction, or simple creative briefs.



Produce finished AI-generated lifestyle and product-on-model visuals for fashion brands.



Generate 20 to 30 or more on-brand visuals per week across multiple clients.



Work across different brand aesthetics including streetwear, vintage Americana, luxury, Y2K, editorial, and commercial fashion.



Own the full AI generation workflow from input to final asset.



Handle prompting, reference matching, image refinement, quality control, and final review.



Make sure products look accurate, models look real, clothes look natural, and the image feels brand-correct.



Work independently with minimal back-and-forth.



Make creative decisions without needing every detail explained.



TOOLS YOU CAN USE



You do not need to use every tool below, but you must have serious experience with AI image generation.



Examples of tools you may use include Higgsfield, Midjourney, Freepik AI, Nano Banana Pro, Runway, Krea, Flux, Photoshop AI, Generative Fill, or any other AI generation tools you are highly skilled in.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You have real AI image generation experience, not casual experimentation.



You can show AI visuals you personally created.



You understand how to make AI images look realistic and commercially usable.



You have a strong fashion eye.



You understand styling, lighting, composition, mood, model casting, product accuracy, and brand aesthetics.



You follow fashion brands, editorials, campaigns, creators, or streetwear culture because you are genuinely interested in it.



You can recreate a brand’s visual world using references.



You can work across different aesthetics without making everything look the same.



You can tell when an image looks cheap, off-brand, fake, or unusable.



You are self-directed and can solve visual problems without waiting for step-by-step instructions.



You take creative ownership and fix issues before sending work.



DO NOT APPLY IF



Do not apply if you only use ChatGPT image generator casually.



Do not apply if you only know how to make generic AI images.



Do not apply if your AI images have fake-looking people, bad faces, bad hands, weird skin, distorted clothes, or unrealistic fabric.



Do not apply if you cannot control brand aesthetic.



Do not apply if you cannot make product details look accurate.



Do not apply if you need constant direction for every image.



Do not apply if you do not have examples of AI visuals you have made.



Do not apply if you are mainly a graphic designer, video editor, or social media manager with only light AI experience.



TO APPLY



Please answer these 5 questions. If you skip them, your application will not be reviewed.



Question 1



Send a portfolio, Google Drive folder, or links to AI-generated visuals you personally created. Fashion, apparel, product-on-model, editorial, or lifestyle examples are strongly preferred.



Question 2



Which AI image tools do you use most, and what do you use each one for?



Question 3



Pick one fashion brand you know well. In 4 to 6 sentences, describe its visual world and how you would recreate that feeling using AI.



Question 4



What do you check before d
 an AI fashion image is ready to send?



Question 5



What is your expected monthly rate in USD for full-time work, and are you comfortable doing a paid test task?

description:

Researching
 groups, niche platforms, Instagram, and other channels, and understanding each community's culture before anything gets posted

Profile positioning, image presentation, and overall trust signals

Suggesting ways to increase visibility without sounding spammy, desperate, defensive, or salesy

The Listing Coordinator will be responsible for managing all listing-related administrative tasks, ensuring listings are entered accurately, updated promptly, and maintained across multiple platforms and systems.

- Listing Agreement

- Seller Property Disclosure

- Dotloop

- AccountTech

- Shared company folders

- List price

- Listing dates

- Agent remarks

- Photos

- Compensation information

Update:

- FMLS

- Georgia MLS

- AccountTech

- Dotloop

- Nekst

Upload supporting amendments and documentation to all required systems.

4. Pending Transactions

Upload executed contracts and supporting documentation.

Update listing status across all systems.

Submit required forms to MLS.

Upload documentation to Dotloop, Nekst, and AccountTech.

Notify agents and office staff of status changes promptly.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Experience with Nekst and AccountTech.

- Georgia real estate transaction experience.

- Knowledge of real estate compliance and disclosure requirements.



Technical Requirements

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Quiet professional work environment.

Service Call Report – True Refrigeration Make Line

Model: TPP-119

Serial: 8994

Arrived on site and found the make line thermostat set to 9 (coldest setting). Compressor and condenser fan motor were off, while the blower was running.

Set the temperature controller to the off position and then back on; the unit resumed operation and reached 31°F, indicating it is mechanically functioning properly.

Observed a clogged air filter and a dirty condenser coil. Filter and condenser coil were cleaned using nitrogen.

Prepare a professional invoice for the work completed during this service visit.

Cleaning performed

Parts and labor

Brief explanation of why repair is recommended

Total estimated price

Use your best judgment and make reasonable assumptions where information is missing.

title: Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel
description:
I THINK WE MISSED A TURN: Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel - TCAT Remapping Expedition 2026



Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel

OVERVIEW

- Craig Luke is a Canadian Moto-Vlogger based in Nelson, British Columbia. He is currently riding solo, coast to coast off-road, to remap the Trans Canada Adventure Trail. 15,000 km from Grant Bay on Vancouver Island to St. John's, Newfoundland. Roughly six months on the dirt road. You are the editor who turns each journey's raw footage into a finished, upload-ready video.

- This is off-road adventure motorcycling content made by riders for riders. Authentic and practical. Real Canadian backcountry travel, not influencer polish. He shoots on a lightweight Kove 450 Rally and lives on a strict $50/day budget. Footage comes off the trail and uploads via Starlink Mini from remote campsites. Every video should feel like the viewer is out there with him.

- Style benchmark is Itchy Boots 
 story-driven pacing built around solo travel, geographic progression, map tracking and the raw beauty of the trail. Not hyper-edited visual noise.

- Publish cadence is once every three days to start. Turnaround is within 48 hours from the moment a journey's assets are ready.



THE ROLE

- We outline each episode in a shared Google Sheet. An episode may cover one day or several days. You build one finished episode per outline.

- We engage you video by video to start.

- If we like your work and we are working well together, we build a longer-term relationship from there.

- We want a go-to editor for the entire 15,000km project across Canada and beyond.

- The production hub is this Google Sheet: 



REVIEW THE CHANNEL FIRST

- Watch the current channel for context and style: 

- We want you to match the rider-to-rider feel and then raise the bar.

- Come with ideas. Better pacing, cleaner sound design, sharper color, smarter cutaways, stronger hooks and openings, chapter markers, retention editing.

- Tell us what you would do differently and why.



REFERENCE VIDEOS (watch before you start)

- Study these before your first edit. They show the target. Match the pacing, energy and storytelling. Do not copy shot for shot.

- Style we are aiming for: youtu.be/t8R4xB9k6xI

- Reference: youtu.be/6cmY8qEdvIM

- Channel benchmark: Itchy Boots, 



SOURCE FOOTAGE

- Craig shoots each day on three cameras.

- Insta360 X4 Air. 360 capture for reframing and impossible angles. 8K.

- Insta360 GO Ultra. Mounted POV and cube shots.

- Phone. Handheld and talking-to-camera footage.



WHERE EVERYTHING LIVES

- Google Sheet (production hub). Every episode outlines lives here. The narrative spine, titles, descriptions, tags, notes, locations and track links. An outline may span multiple days. This is your starting point for every episode.

- Google Drive day folders. Raw footage from the three cameras, photos of people and scenery, Craig's voiceover and in most cases the route map video file.

- 
. The route map is usually dropped into the Drive folder as a finished video. In some cases over the next two weeks you may need to grab the route video for the day from 
 yourself. Craig is moving toward providing it automatically in the folder.

- Insta360 Studio app. Where you reframe and export the 360 footage before Premiere, or you use the Insta360 plugin inside Premiere instead.



THE 360 WORKFLOW

- You handle the 360 footage one of two ways.

- Reframe and export the 360 footage in the Insta360 Studio app first, then bring it into Adobe Premiere Pro.

- Or use the Adobe Premiere Pro Insta360 plugin to import and reframe the .insv files directly inside Premiere.

- Pick the path your machine handles cleanly. Everything finishes in Premiere.



WHAT YOU BUILD

- One finished episode per outline.

- The route map worked into the video. Most days the map video is already in the Drive folder. Occasionally you pull it from 
.

- Craig's voiceover laid in as the spine of the story.

- The pre-made intro and outro applied to every video.

- People and scenery photos worked in as cutaways and b-roll where they fit the story.



EDIT APPROACH

- Follow the outline in the Google Sheet as the spine. It tells you where Craig was, where he was going and what happened.

- Cut for story first, polish second. The ride is the star. Find the arc. Geographic progress, the struggle, the breakdown, the triumph, the camp routine.

- Keep it honest. No fake drama. Sound like a rider, not a brand.

- Reframe the X4 360 footage to land the action. Use the small POV cam for mounted shots. Use the phone for Craig to camera.

- Pacing and sound design. Balance voiceover and music against crisp engine audio, wind and ambient nature sound. Build tension on technical trail. Go cinematic and calm at camp. The voice stays clear and on top.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND HARDWARE

- Expert editor in Adobe Premiere Pro. This is the only editor we use. We want every project built in Premiere so we can bring editing in-house later.

- Insta360 workflow. Reframe and stabilize 360 footage cleanly. Run the Insta360 Reframe plugin in Premiere or reframe and export in the Insta360 Studio app first.

- Handle heavy 4K and 8K files smoothly.

- Audio layering and sound design. Balance voiceover, camera audio, engine sound and music so the voice stays crystal clear.

- Story editing. Find the narrative arc in hours of raw trail footage without over-editing. The Itchy Boots flow.

- Strong English comprehension. You follow written outlines and check on-screen metadata against what actually happened on camera.

- Reliable communication and on-time delivery inside the 48 hour window.

- Fast internet and a high-spec machine. You will pull heavy 8K and 4K files from Google Drive and the Insta360 cloud.



NICE TO HAVE (strong bonus, not required)

- Map and motion graphics. Generate route paths from GPX using Google Earth Studio, After Effects or a dedicated mapping plugin. In most cases the route map is provided for you. Relive supplies the motion graphics if they come on as a sponsor. Otherwise we build it through Google Maps or another option. This is a real plus if you can do it.

- After Effects for titles, lower thirds and clean motion graphics.

- Color grading in Lumetri.

- Thumbnail design.

- Experience editing travel, moto, outdoor or adventure content.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN YOU

- Detail focused. You catch the small things.

- Self-managed. We do not track your hours. You hold the milestones and the quality.

- A storyteller, not just a button pusher.

- In it for the long haul. We want one editor for the whole expedition.



DELIVERY AND APPROVAL



- Drop two files back into the journey's Google Drive folder. The Adobe Premiere master project file (once approved and finalized) and the finished video file.

- Do not upload anything to YouTube. We handle that ourselves for now. We bring you into that once we have worked together for a while.

- Use the title, description and tags from the Google Sheet. If Craig covered something on camera that was not in the outline, update the metadata to match what actually happened.

- Tell us the episode is ready for review. All of this inside the 48 hour turnaround window.



COMPENSATION AND WORK TERMS



- We are a Canadian company. All pay is in Canadian dollars (CAD).

- Structure. Paid per completed video. One finished longform episode, 15 to 20 minutes.

- Trial rate. $65 CAD per video for your first 3 videos. This is a paid trial so we both confirm the fit.

- Standard rate. $100 CAD per video from video 4 onward, once the trial passes review and we are working well together.

- Growth bonus. When the channel hits 20,000 subscribers you earn a bonus on every video on top of your per-video rate.

- Performance bonus. Once the channel revenue grows we add a bonus tied to views on the videos you personally edit. This is added to your base, never in place of it.

- Monthly retainer. When the channel is profitable we are willing to move you to a monthly retainer plus bonuses.

- Payment schedule. Paid after each video is completed. We move to a monthly salary when the channel hits 50,000 subscribers. Paid in CAD.

- Flexibility. We do not track your hours. You manage your own schedule as long as the milestones and quality hold for each delivery.

- Long-term potential. We want one go-to editor for the full 15,000km project across Canada and beyond.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully)

- We only hire people who pay attention to detail. Automated or copy-pasted applications get ignored. In your application include the items below.

- The secret phrase. Start your message with this exact line: "I found the turn! - ITWMAT Video Editor".

- Your portfolio. Links to YouTube or adventure content you personally edited. Include examples with maps or heavy voiceover.

- Production ideas. After watching the channel, name two or three specific things you would do to raise the production quality.

- Your project rate. Confirm our per-video structure works, or give your target rate in CAD per 15 to 20 minute finished video.

- Your gear and connection. A short description of your computer specs and a screenshot of your internet download and upload speed.



NEXT STEP

- Watch both reference videos and the current channel, then reply with your questions on the open specs and your production ideas so we can lock everything before the first folder lands.

About Us

M-23 Mechanical is a leading provider of innovative and efficient HVAC solutions for commercial projects specializing in TI, market ready, lab spaces and medical. We pride ourselves on precision, quality, and a commitment to client satisfaction. Our team is growing, and we are looking for a talented and detail-oriented professional to join us in a key dual-role position.



The Opportunity

We are seeking a skilled and motivated HVAC Estimator & CAD Designer to play a pivotal role in our project lifecycle. In this unique position, you will be the bridge between our sales/engineering and operations teams. You will be responsible for creating accurate project estimates/proposals and transforming those concepts into detailed, build-ready drawings. Your work will directly contribute to our ability to win projects and execute them flawlessly.



Key Responsibilities

HVAC Estimating (Approx. 80%):



Analyze project plans, specifications, and other documentation to prepare comprehensive time, cost, and labor estimates for HVAC projects.



Perform quantity take-offs for materials, equipment, and labor.



Solicit and review quotes from vendors and subcontractors.



Prepare detailed and competitive bid proposals for a variety of projects.



Collaborate with sales managers, project managers, and engineers to ensure estimates are accurate and feasible.



Participate in pre-bid meetings and site walk-throughs as needed.



Maintain and update a database of costs and estimating tools.



CAD Design & Drafting (Approx. 20%):



Develop detailed HVAC design drawings, including ductwork layout, piping plans, equipment schedules, and installation details using AutoCAD and/or AutoCAD MEP.



Convert preliminary concepts and design sketches into permit and construction-ready drawings.



Coordinate with architects, engineers, and other trades to resolve design conflicts through detailed drawings.



Ensure all designs and drawings comply with company standards, project specifications, and relevant codes (IMC, IECC, etc.).



Revise and update drawings based on redlines and feedback from project managers and field personnel.



What You Bring (Qualifications & Experience)

Required:



Proven experience (5+ years) in HVAC estimation and CAD design/drafting.



**Fast Duct Experienced Preferred** 



High proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; experience with AutoCAD MEP or Revit MEP is a significant plus.



Strong understanding of HVAC systems, components, and principles.



Solid knowledge of mechanical codes and construction practices.



Excellent mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.



Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.



Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



Preferred:



Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Drafting Technology, Construction Management, or a related field.



Experience with estimating software (e.g., FastDuct, Bluebeam, AutoCAD).

title: Head of Contact Center Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Head of Contact Center Operations is the senior execution leader of MedPro and MP1's contact center — the person who makes the operation run, improves it continuously, and manages the managers who manage the floor. You report to the VP of Operations and translate their strategic direction into daily operational reality.



This role sits at the intersection of operator and thought partner. You have done this before: run high-volume, multi-channel service environments, built capacity plans between labor and systems, designed operating models from the ground up, and led teams through system migrations without losing service continuity. You are not here to hold the org steady — you are here to elevate it.



Where the VP of Operations sets the vision, you own delivery. When the VP of Operations needs to present performance to the COO, the data, the narrative, and the operational confidence behind it come from you. When the organization needs its service processes redesigned, its CRM environment assessed, or its team structure rebuilt — that work belongs to you.



Key Responsibilities:

Multi-Layer Team Leadership & People Development

• Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Team Leads — you manage the managers, and they manage the floor. Build leaders who build others.

• Establish clear performance expectations, coaching cadences, and accountability frameworks across all leadership levels — weekly 1:1s, call calibrations, structured performance reviews, and real-time feedback loops.

• Drive workforce planning and capacity modeling: design the right staffing structure between labor, channels, and volume patterns — not just fill headcount, but engineer capacity.

• Build succession plans and internal development pathways that reduce external hiring dependency and create a promotion pipeline from within.

• Own recruitment strategy for the operations team in partnership with HR — attract, hire, and retain the caliber of leader and frontline talent that the CSO model demands.

• Foster a performance culture aligned to MedPro's values: Do the Right Thing, Figure It Out, Win as a Team, and Accountability & Ownership.



Operating Model Design & Service Delivery

• Assess the current state of the contact center operation — people, process, structure, channels, and systems — and translate findings into a clear-eyed redesign plan with sequenced priorities.

• Design and implement the operating model: how the team is structured, how work flows through channels, how performance is governed, and how the organization scales as the client base grows.

• Own day-to-day operational performance across all service channels — inbound and outbound voice,
, chat, and SMS — with direct accountability for SLA attainment, handle time, first-contact resolution, and quality scores.

• Build and maintain the full SOP and playbook library: every process documented, auditable, and owned. If it is not written down, it does not exist.

• Own the quality assurance framework — define rubrics, conduct or oversee audits, deliver structured coaching feedback to leads, and use quality data to drive continuous improvement.

• Manage real-time workload distribution across channels — monitor queues, adjust staffing deployment as volume shifts, and act on performance signals without waiting to be asked.



System Assessment & Service Technology Migration

• Conduct a thorough assessment of the current CRM and service technology environment — understanding what exists, what is working, what is limiting, and what migration path forward best serves the operation.

• Lead the end-to-end service system migration: requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, workflow configuration, data mapping, agent training, parallel testing, and go-live — while maintaining service continuity throughout.

• Design and configure case management workflows, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and omni-channel routing logic in the new system, aligned to MedPro's service model and client base.

• Partner with the internal technology team to ensure all system integrations — IVR handoffs, client account data, ticketing — flow cleanly from day one.

• Build post-migration operating model documentation: how cases are created, routed, resolved, escalated, and reported — so no process lives in someone's head.

• Drive full agent and Team Lead adoption: training materials, live coaching sessions, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics in the new system until it is the single active system of record.

• Design, build, and maintain IVR call flows that intelligently route clients, reduce handle time, and improve containment — build these, not just manage ones that already exist.



Performance Management, Data & Reporting

• Own the KPI framework — define the right metrics, build the dashboards, and drive accountability systems that make performance visible and improvable at every level of the team.

• Deliver structured weekly and monthly performance reports to the VP of Operations — covering channel SLA attainment, CSAT trends, quality scores, case volume, and system migration status.

• Translate floor-level data into operational decisions and clear narrative: what is driving variance, what specific action will improve it, and what the risk is if it is not addressed.

• Communicate proactively to the VP of Operations about service risks, capacity issues, and migration blockers — full transparency, solution-first framing, no surprises that should have been visible earlier.

• Identify and scope AI-assist and automation opportunities (IVR containment, agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection) — bring the VP of Operations a prioritized business case, not just ideas.



Client Experience & Regulatory Compliance

• Own the client experience at the operational level — serving as the escalation point for complex service issues and ensuring every client interaction reflects MedPro and MP1's positioning as a true compliance partner.

• Map and continuously improve the client journey across all contact touchpoints — identifying friction, closing gaps, and driving measurable improvements in client satisfaction scores.

• Ensure operational adherence to all applicable data security, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements including HIPAA and related standards.

• Partner with Sales and Client Success to align operational delivery with client growth, renewal, and expansion strategies.



Qualifications:

Required

• 10–15 years of total experience in contact center operations, service delivery, or BPO leadership — with significant, demonstrable accountability for team performance, service transformation, and operational change.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior people-management role with direct accountability for multi-layer teams (managers managing managers), department-level KPIs, and operational planning. Candidates who have only managed frontline teams — and not managed managers — will not be a fit.

• Proven experience operating in high-volume, multi-channel service environments with large numbers of customer interactions across voice,
, chat, and digital touchpoints. This is an execution role — we need someone who has run the floor at volume, not just designed programs from above it.

• Demonstrated experience leading a service system migration in a live contact center — transitioning a team from a legacy CRM to a modern platform while maintaining service continuity. Salesforce Service Cloud experience is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on capacity planning expertise: ability to model the right labor structure against channel mix, volume forecasts, and SLA requirements — and build the operating model that delivers it.

• Deep IVR design and multi-channel routing experience — you have built IVR flows from scratch, configured routing logic, and measured containment impact.

• Strong analytical capability — builds and interprets dashboards, identifies performance drivers, and communicates findings clearly to senior leadership.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for daily interaction with U.S.-based leadership.

• Background in healthcare BPO, compliance services, regulated service industries, or U.S.-facing contact center operations strongly preferred.



Nice-to-Have

• Salesforce Service Cloud proficiency — case management, workflow rules, SLA configuration, omni-channel routing, and reporting.

• Experience with AI-assist tools in contact center settings: agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection, predictive routing.

• Workforce management platform experience (NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar).

• HIPAA familiarity and/or exposure to U.S. healthcare regulatory compliance operations.

• Track record of building or rebuilding operations within a high-growth or category-defining company.

• Six Sigma, COPC, or equivalent contact center quality certification.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $18-$24/hr 

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays

• Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment!



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards.

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• Noise-canceling headset/headphones

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home



Application Process:

1. Your most updated resume.



2. Submit to all of these
s:

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: AI Design Lead (Senior Graphic Designer — Remote)
description:
**Now Hiring: AI Design Lead (Senior Graphic Designer — Remote)**



**About Us**

We're a growing e-commerce team running several successful U.S. Etsy stores. We sell custom baby apparel, mugs, tumblers, and Christmas ornaments. Our style is fun, modern, cute, and family-friendly.



See our work here:



- FunDayStudiosCo: 
/shop/FunDayStudiosCo

- MiniMeeCollection: 
/shop/MiniMeeCollection



This is a long-term remote role with steady work, weekly team communication, and real room to grow into a leadership position.



**About the Role**

This is an **AI-first, senior-level role.** We're looking for a designer who lives and breathes AI tools and knows print-on-demand inside and out. You'll lead our design output — not just create it. You'll set the standard, build the systems, and help our team work faster and smarter with AI.



**Who You Are**

You're highly motivated and hungry to grow. You're always learning, always leveling up your skills, and excited to build something long-term with a team that's growing fast. You bring fresh energy and ideas, and you treat every project as a chance to get better.



**What You'll Do**



- Create high-quality PNG designs for baby onesies, toddler shirts, mugs, tumblers, and holiday ornaments

- Build and document repeatable AI design workflows (prompts, templates, processes) for the team

- Stay on top of the latest AI tools and recommend what we should adopt

- Lead and train other designers, reviewing their work for quality and brand consistency

- Follow our naming and delivery guidelines (we'll train you on these)



**What We're Looking For**



- **Print-on-demand experience is a must** — you've worked with Printify and other print suppliers and understand their design requirements, file specs, and delivery process

- **2+ years of design experience** AND a portfolio that clearly shows hands-on AI tool use

- Mastery of (or the ability to quickly learn) **Higgsfield** and **Claude** — these are our core AI tools

- **Etsy experience is a strong plus**

- Comfortable with Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator

- A strong eye for layout, color, and fonts

- Creative, detail-oriented, reliable, and responsive

- Trend-aware and comfortable using Pinterest and Etsy for inspiration

- A leader who can give clear direction, follow instructions, and welcome feedback and revisions



*Note: You don't need prior experience designing these specific products (onesies, mugs, etc.). If you know print-on-demand and AI, we can train you on the rest.*



**Pay & Perks**

Starting at **$650/month**, with rate renegotiation every quarter. Performance bonuses available. **We provide Higgsfield access**, so you'll have the AI tools you need from day one.



**Busy Season (October–December)**

This is our peak season, so please note:



- No time off during these three months

- Custom orders run Monday through Saturday

- You must be available daily and able to meet fast turnaround deadlines

- Overtime may be required — and all overtime hours are paid



**AI Tools & Transparency**

This role is built around AI. We expect you to use tools like Higgsfield and Claude daily — and to clearly disclose your AI use in your work. We value transparency and originality. Misrepresenting AI-generated work as fully original will lead to disqualification.



**Hiring Process**

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short 1–2 task design trial.



**How to Apply**

Send us:



1. Your portfolio (especially print-on-demand and AI-assisted work)

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Your availability

4. Which print suppliers you've worked with (Printify, etc.) and which AI tools you use and how they fit into your workflow



Please include the word **"5050"** in your message so we know you read the full post.



If your style fits what we do, we'd love to hear from you!
