title: Certified Medical Coder / Coding Auditor — Orthopedic & Spine Physician Claims
description:
We are looking for an experienced U.S. medical coder / coding auditor with strong experience in orthopedic, spine, and musculoskeletal physician coding.



Our company, MedCode Pro, helps physicians and procedural clinics identify CPT codes, modifiers, add-on codes, and documentation requirements that may have been missed during billing.



We are performing audits where we review approximately 60 days of clinic claims and compare the billed codes against the supporting clinical notes. The focus will be orthopedic and spine-related physician services, including clinic visits, procedures, injections, and operative notes.



This role is ideal for someone who can read provider documentation and determine what codes are supported, what may have been missed, and what documentation is needed to support the recommendation.



Responsibilities

- Review de-identified orthopedic and spine-related clinical notes, procedure notes, operative reports, and claim/superbill data



- Compare documented services against codes that were actually billed



- Identify potential missed CPT codes, add-on codes, modifiers, HCPCS codes, and ICD-10-CM opportunities

- Review E/M coding where relevant, including documentation support and modifier use

- Flag documentation gaps where a code may be possible but not fully supported

- Identify potential undercoding, overcoding, bundling, unbundling, or compliance risks

- Provide a clear coding rationale for each recommendation

- Summarize findings in a structured audit format



Specialty Focus

We are especially interested in experience with:

- Orthopedic surgery

- Spine surgery

-Musculoskeletal procedures

- Pain-related spine procedures

- Injections and procedure coding

- Imaging-guided procedures, if applicable

- E/M coding for orthopedic clinics

- Modifiers commonly used in physician billing

- Add-on codes and bundled procedure logic



Required Qualifications

Experience with U.S. physician/professional fee coding



Experience coding or auditing orthopedic, spine, or musculoskeletal claims



Strong understanding of CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and modifiers



Ability to read clinical documentation and determine what codes are supported



Experience reviewing clinic notes, procedure notes, operative reports, claims, or superbills



Strong written English



Detail-oriented and able to explain coding rationale clearly



Comfortable working with spreadsheets or structured audit templates



Preferred Qualifications

CPC, CCS-P, CPMA, or similar certification



Orthopedic coding experience or specialty certification



Experience as a medical coding auditor, ProFee coder, physician coding auditor, or revenue integrity coding specialist



Experience identifying missed CPT codes, add-on codes, modifiers, or undercoding



Experience with NCCI edits, bundling rules, payer rules, denials, or documentation improvement



Familiarity with orthopedic/spine coding areas such as:

Arthroscopy

Fracture care

Joint procedures

Spine decompression/fusion procedures

Epidural steroid injections

Facet injections / medial branch blocks

Radiofrequency ablation

Trigger point / joint injections

Durable medical equipment, braces, or orthotics, if applicable



Important

We are not looking for someone who only has experience with basic billing, charge entry, payment posting, or AR follow-up.



We need someone who can independently review documentation and answer:

“Based on this orthopedic or spine note, what could have been coded, what was missed, and what documentation supports the recommendation?”

description:
SCOPE OF WORK (GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION)

SPECIALIST needed to build a list of creators for Pixies Brew, a specialty single-serve pour-over coffee brand. The objective is to find 50 nano and micro creators we can send free product to (gifting / product seeding) on Instagram and TikTok.



Your outcome is to:

1. Build a list of 50 US-based creators on Instagram or TikTok within the parameters below.

2. Highlight creators who feel like the strongest aesthetic and audience fit for the brand.



Success for this project is delivering a clean, complete Google Sheet of 50 vetted creators we would actually want to send product to.



KEY BULLET POINTS

- Required: Follower count between 1,000 and 100,000 on Instagram or TikTok.

- Required: US-based. The brand only ships in the US. Do not add creators outside the US.

- Required: Engagement rate of 2% or higher (formula below).

- Required: Active in the last 30 days. Public account. Contact method available 
, contact button, or DM).

- Required: Posts in at least one of our target niches (see below).

- Required: Submit a list of 50 vetted creators.

- Ideal: Creator already posts about coffee, slow living, or aesthetic morning routines.

- Ideal: Creator has a business
 or contact button in their bio.





OVERVIEW & DETAILS

Pixies Brew is a specialty coffee brand built around ritual, intention, and slowing down. Each blend is a little pixie character with its own personality. The brand vibe is calm, aesthetic, whimsical, story-driven.



Brand 



Target niches (creator must fit at least one):

- Specialty coffee

- Slow living / aesthetic morning routines

- Cozy / cottagecore lifestyle

- Bookish, journaling, or creative content (booktok, art, playlists)

- Travel or camping lifestyle



Good fit: Soft, aesthetic creators. Calm pacing. Natural lighting. World-building energy.



Bad fit: Loud creators. Hustle culture. Energy drinks. Gaming. "Main character" personalities.





EXAMPLES OF CREATORS WE'VE LOOKED AT

(These are profiles, not real handles. Finding real creators that match is your job.)

- ~15K on Instagram - Slow aesthetic morning routines, journaling, soft warm color grading. High saves and comments.

- ~40K on TikTok - Specialty coffee reviews, tasting notes, pour-over gear.

- ~30K - Booktok or journaling. Cozy reading nooks. Calm and aesthetic.

- ~8K on TikTok - Cottagecore. Candles, books, warm drinks. Small but engaged.

- ~25K - Travel and on-the-go lifestyle. Hotel and campsite coffee 
nts.





HOW TO CALCULATE ENGAGEMENT RATE

Look at the last 5 posts on the platform you list them under.

1. Avg likes = total likes from last 5 posts divided by 5

2. Avg comments = total comments from last 5 posts divided by 5

3. Engagement Rate = ((avg likes + avg comments) divided by follower count) x 100



Write it as a percentage with one decimal. Example: 3.4%





LIST BUILDING DETAILS

Please build the list in a Google Sheet. Include the following columns:

- Creator Name - Their name or brand name.

- Platform - Instagram or TikTok (pick the one you measured).

- Handle 
 Profile URL - Direct link to their profile.

- Follower Count - Exact number.

- US-Based? - Yes, and how you confirmed it (bio, location tag, content).

- Niche - Which target niche they fit.

- Avg Likes (last 5 posts) - Number.

- Avg Comments (last 5 posts) - Number.

- Engagement Rate % - One decimal.

- Contact Method -
, contact button, or DM.

- Best Recent Post (link) - Link to one post that shows why they fit.

- Why They Fit - One sentence.



If a creator is missing a required column, they do not go on the list.





PAY

This is a one-time project, paid in full on completion and approval of the finished sheet.

- Rate: $65 flat for the completed 50-creator list.

- Payment by PayPal, sent immediately once the sheet is approved.

- Rate agreed in writing before you start. No payment before the work is done.





TO APPLY:

Send an
 to 
 with the TITLE: "Pixies Brew Gifting List Building Application"



INCLUDE:

- 3 creators you think would be ideal for this project. For each one give: handle, platform, follower count, and one sentence on why they fit. (This is so we know you can do the rest of the work.) Thoughtful picks will get you the job. This is the most important part of the application.

- A short description of your experience and/or portfolio, and why you're confident you can do this work.

We will NOT consider:

Thank you!

title: Executive Assistant & Accountability Operator
description:
Read the whole thing before applying. This is not a normal EA role.

I’m a founder running multiple companies. My problem isn’t strategy or knowledge — I have those in abundance. My problem is execution, discipline, and consistency. I need someone whose entire job is to make sure I do what I say I’ll do, every single day, no exceptions.

This is not a “you’ve got this!” cheerleader role. If you’re soft, gentle, and like to encourage people along — you’ll hate this and I’ll move past your application. I need someone relentless. Someone who calls me every 90 minutes asking “what’s next?” Someone who calls five times in a row when I go quiet. Someone who refuses my excuses, logs every miss honestly, and treats my time as more valuable than their own comfort.

If that sounds intense — good. That’s the job.

WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO

• Own my calendar end to end — plan every day, block everything, move and cancel as needed

• Hold me to my daily non-negotiables: morning routine, deep-work blocks, a daily revenue action, sleep/wake discipline

• Check in relentlessly — every 90 minutes, and after every task: “Done? What’s next?”

• Chase me when I go dark. Persistence is the point, not the problem.

• Run my communication — draft my WhatsApp/Slack messages, then once trusted, send as me, so nothing sits

• Make sure tasks I set for my team actually get done daily — follow up, track, report

• Find my menial and repeated tasks and kill them — delegate or systemise

• Track my performance — collect the data on what I hit and miss, and show me the patterns

• Weigh in. You’re a soldier and an advisor. If I’m prioritising wrong, tell me.

NON-NEGOTIABLES

• Full-time, I’m your only real client (a tiny side commitment that doesn’t pull focus is fine — heavy ones aren’t)

• You work Bali time (UTC+8) — from when I wake to when I sleep. If you can’t be there across the majority of my full day, this won’t work.

• Fluent, confident English — you’re on calls with me all day and messaging people as me

WHO THRIVES HERE

Ex-military, ex-coach, high level executive assistant — anyone who’s held people to a standard they didn’t want to meet. EA experience helps, but I can teach admin. I can’t teach backbone.

DETAILS

• $1,500–$2,000/month USD to start, based on your profile — grows as you prove yourself

• Paid one-week trial before we lock in

• Start within 7 days

TO APPLY, SEND ME

1. A short note on a time you held someone to a standard they didn’t want to meet — what you did and what happened.

2. Your time zone, and confirm you can work Bali hours full-time.

3. One line: why this role fits you.

title: Boot Systems Developer
description:
Job Description: x86 System Boot Loader Designer



Position Overview: We are seeking a talented and experienced x86/ARM System Boot Loader Designer to join our team. As a Boot Loader Designer, you will play a critical role in developing and designing the software responsible for initializing x86/ARM-based computer systems during the boot process. Your expertise in low-level programming, firmware development, system architecture, and familiarity with Linux Kernel, Linux containers, and FlexBuild tool will contribute to ensuring reliable and efficient booting operations.



Responsibilities:



Develop and design the boot loader software for x86/ARM-based computer systems, including BIOS and UEFI firmware.



Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, firmware developers, and system architects, to define boot requirements and specifications.



Conduct thorough research on system booting technologies and stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and advancements.



Implement low-level programming and optimization techniques to enhance boot performance and reduce boot time.



Customize boot loaders to support specific hardware configurations and system requirements.



Debug and troubleshoot boot-related issues, both independently and in collaboration with the firmware development team.



Conduct thorough testing and validation of the boot loader software to ensure its reliability and compatibility with target systems.



Document design specifications, architectural diagrams, and code structures for future reference and knowledge sharing.



Collaborate with the software engineering team to integrate the boot loader with the operating system and other software components.



Provide technical support and guidance to internal teams and external stakeholders regarding boot loader-related queries and issues.



Qualifications:



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.



Strong understanding of x86 architecture and system booting processes.



Proficiency in low-level programming languages, such as Assembly and C/C++.



Experience with BIOS and UEFI firmware development, including familiarity with related standards and protocols.



In-depth knowledge of boot loader technologies, including boot stages, boot protocols, and boot loader customization.



Familiarity with system-level debugging tools, such as JTAG, GDB, and kernel debuggers.



Experience with firmware development tools, such as Intel System Studio, UEFI Development Kit (UDK), or similar.



Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex boot-related issues.



Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams.



Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet project deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications:



Prior experience in designing boot loaders for embedded systems or real-time operating systems.



Knowledge of security features and considerations related to booting and firmware development.



Familiarity with virtualization technologies, such as Intel VT-x or AMD-V.



Experience with Linux kernel development, Linux containers, and knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.



Familiarity with the FlexBuild tool for building Linux systems or similar build automation tools.



Join our team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge x86-based computer systems. As an x86/ARM System Boot Loader Designer, you will have the opportunity to work on complex firmware development projects and play a vital role in shaping the booting experience of our products, leveraging your knowledge and experience with Linux Kernel, Linux containers, and FlexBuild tool.

title: Engineering Manager (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering manager who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

• Worked alongside TPMs or Product Managers

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

In this unique position, you will be the bridge between our sales/engineering and operations teams. You will be responsible for creating accurate project estimates and transforming those concepts into detailed, build-ready drawings. What You Bring (Qualifications & Experience)

Strong understanding of HVAC systems, components, and principles.



Solid knowledge of mechanical codes and construction practices.

Preferred:

Knowledge of building information modeling (BIM) processes.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain

 Page:

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

s or

Play both the customer and the company representative

Speak clearly, naturally, and at a normal pace

Do NOT read word-for-word — we want it to sound like a real call

Record in a quiet environment (no background noise)

Scenario to Act Out:



A customer calls because their AC is not working properly on a hot day.



Include the following in your call:



Greeting and introduction

Asking for the customer’s name and contact information

Understanding the issue (ask at least 2–3 questions)

Show empathy and professionalism

Offer scheduling options

Confirm next steps clearly

Example Structure (Do NOT read this exactly):



You (Tiger Air):

“Hi, thank you for calling Tiger Air, this is [Your Name]. How can I help you today?”



Customer:

“My AC is blowing warm air and it’s really hot in the house.”



You:

“I’m sorry to hear that — I know how uncomfortable that can be, especially in this heat. Let me ask you a couple quick questions so we can get this taken care of.”



(Ask questions like:)



When did this start?

Is the unit turning on at all?

Has this issue happened before?



Then:

title: Product Manager (Technical) / Software Architect
description:
We are seeking a Technical Product Manager / Architect who bridges product design and engineering execution. This role combines system-level thinking, architectural oversight, and clear, actionable documentation—producing deliverables engineers can build from directly. The ideal candidate can translate business needs into architecture diagrams, wireframes, and well-scoped tickets with code-level precision, ensuring efficient handoff and reduced rework.



Requirements & Documentation

• Author architecture-aware product specifications including system diagrams, logic flows, and key technical dependencies.

• Prepare engineer-ready tickets, including pseudocode, scaffolding, or sample API structures.

• Conduct architecture and code reviews, identifying potential design or implementation issues early.

• Build wireframes, mockups, and interaction flows using Figma or equivalent tools to align engineering and UX/UI early in the cycle.

• Collaborate with engineering to ensure technical feasibility and architectural scalability before feature commitment.

Cross-Functional Execution

• Work closely with engineering leads to break down architecture into structured deliverables and sprint-ready tasks.

• Lead technical review sessions to validate assumptions and architecture decisions before coding begins.



Qualifications

• Strong understanding of software architecture principles, REST APIs, and modular system design.

• Hands-on experience writing or reviewing code in PHP, JavaScript, and SQL preferred.

• Proficiency in creating wireframes, prototypes, and UI flows that accurately reflect data and system constraints.

• Ability to evaluate trade-offs between architectural purity, delivery speed, and scalability.

• Prior experience functioning as a bridge between engineering and design, ensuring clarity and readiness for execution.

- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team

- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required

- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"

title: Analytical "systems brain" to build and run the backend of a sensitive personal operation
description:
I'm looking for someone sharp, organized, independent, and discreet to own the data and operations layer of a sensitive personal project, tracking, analysis, reporting, and research.

This is not a typical admin VA role, and it is not data entry. There is currently very little structure: a small but growing flow of leads and conversations across platforms, early results worth tracking properly, and decisions that need better information behind them. Your job is to impose order on that, design the tracking, define what's worth measuring, build the reports, and tell me what the data says, even when there isn't much of it yet.

This suits someone who likes owning a domain end to end, building systems from scratch, and forming a reasoned read from incomplete information rather than waiting for perfect data.

What you'd own:



Designing and running a simple tracking system (spreadsheet/Airtable-level) for leads, conversations, sources, and stage-by-stage follow-ups

A regular short report: what's working, where the funnel leaks, what I should d
 next

Source analysis, which platforms and communities actually produce serious inquiries, not just traffic

Research projects: comparing platforms, summarizing regional regulations, investigating how similar operations are run

Flagging flaws in my reasoning or plans when you see them. I want pushback, not compliance.



What you would not do: communicate with leads or anyone the project serves, handle medical or legal conversations, or make outward-facing decisions. This is a backend role, the thinking and the systems, not the front door. You'd work with significant autonomy; I care about the quality of your reasoning and your output, not your hours or your process.

The ideal person is:



Naturally structured, you organize information without being told to

Comfortable drawing conclusions from limited data and saying "here's my read, and here's my confidence in it"

Direct in communication; comfortable disagreeing with me when warranted

Discreet, and careful with private information as a matter of course

Strong in written English, precise rather than wordy

title: BIM Modeller / Scan-to-BIM Specialist
description:
About 3D Walkabout



3D Walkabout is an Australian 3D scanning and digital modelling company delivering high-quality scan-to-BIM, as-built documentation, CAD, 3D modelling, and digital twin solutions for clients across construction, architecture, engineering, manufacturing, renovation, and fabrication.



We work on a wide variety of projects, including building renovations, as-built surveys, product modelling, fabrication support, architectural documentation, and modelling from point clouds, 2D drawings, and drone imagery.



We are looking for a skilled BIM Modeller / Scan-to-BIM Specialist based in the Philippines to join our remote production team.



About the Role



You will be responsible for converting 3D scan data and point clouds into accurate BIM, CAD, and 3D model outputs. This role is ideal for someone with strong Revit, point cloud, CAD, and modelling experience who understands scan-to-BIM workflows and can work independently with Australian project requirements.



You may also assist with coordinating and quality-checking work produced by our existing offshore scan-to-BIM production partner in India.



Key Responsibilities



Your work may include:

- Scan-to-BIM modelling up to LOD 400

- Converting E57 point clouds to BIM / RVT

- Processing and cleaning point cloud data

- Converting E57 to RCP / ReCap

- Creating 2D DWG CAD drawings from E57 point clouds, including furniture and MEP elements

- Creating 3D models from 2D drawings

- Supporting as-built modelling for buildings, renovations, and fabrication projects

- Product and object modelling from scan data

- Photogrammetry and modelling from drone aerial imagery

- Reviewing and quality-checking BIM/CAD outputs from external production teams

- Coordinating modelling tasks with overseas production partners when required

- Maintaining high accuracy, clean file structure, and consistent modelling standards



Experience with point cloud data from any of the following scanners is highly regarded:

- Matterport Pro3

- Einscan Rigil

- Leica BLK360

- Trimble X7



You do not need to have operated all of these scanners, but you should be comfortable working with point cloud files and scan-based modelling workflows.



Required Skills and Experience



The ideal candidate will have:

- Strong experience in Autodesk Revit

- Experience with scan-to-BIM workflows

- Ability to work from E57, RCP, RCS, ASC, DWG, and RVT files

- Experience creating accurate as-built models from point clouds

- Good understanding of architectural, structural, and MEP modelling

- Ability to produce clean and accurate 2D CAD drawings

- Experience with Autodesk ReCap or similar point cloud processing software

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Ability to follow modelling standards and project instructions

- Good written English communication skills

- Ability to work remotely and manage deadlines independently





The following skills would be a strong advantage:

- Experience with LOD 300 to LOD 400 BIM modelling

- Experience managing or checking work from other BIM modellers

- Experience with offshore BIM production coordination

- Experience with fabrication modelling

- Experience converting ASC to STP / STEP

- Experience with mesh cleanup, reverse engineering, or product modelling

- Experience with drone photogrammetry workflows

- Experience with Navisworks, AutoCAD, Rhino, SolidWorks, Cyclone, CloudCompare, or similar tools



We are looking for someone who is:

- Accurate and detail-oriented

- Reliable and deadline-focused

- Comfortable working with point cloud data

- Able to solve modelling problems independently

- Good at communicating progress and raising issues early

- Interested in long-term remote work with an Australian company

- Capable of reviewing and managing work from other production teams over time

- Working Arrangement

- Remote role based in the Philippines

- Work with an Australian team

- Full-time preferred, but strong part-time or contract candidates may be considered

- Long-term opportunity for the right person



Please send us:

- Your CV or resume

- Examples of scan-to-BIM, Revit, CAD, or point cloud projects you have completed

- A short description of your experience with point cloud modelling

- Your software experience

- Your availability and expected monthly salary or hourly rate



Please include the subject line:

Application – Remote BIM Modeller Philippines
